sections: Prestart, Active, Inactive, Body, and Tail Element Definitions
predicates: Merge writes all body lanes; selection bit0 chooses vs2, bit1 chooses vs1/scalar/immediate. It never suppresses a body write.
Move writes all body lanes from vs1/scalar/immediate, ignores v0 selection, encodes vm1 and vs2=0.
RV32 scalar is truncated at smaller SEW and sign-extended at SEW64; five-bit immediates are signed.
Both instructions preserve prestart, no-body and undisturbed tail state. Tail-agnostic values use old/all-ones allowed sets, including fractional LMUL storage.
Merge destination-v0 and nonzero-vs2 move encodings are separate unexecuted reserved declarations.
Move source-v0 and destination-v0 are legal data paths and have separate cases.
Source/destination overlap consumes captured prestate, with group alignment and all non-destination registers preserved.
Independent comparison must compare both selected and unselected body lanes; fixed Spike/Sail packets are required before any execution credit.
All 32 signed immediate encodings are declared; zero/full/partial/chunk lengths, nonzero start interactions, policies, selection patterns and six VLENs reuse finite geometry obligations.
